desc: Re-derive the greedy logic for `get_min_moves(k)`: initial pass of n moves plus 2 moves per extra visit, with carry-over of visits between adjacent positions (right-to-left sweep).
Implement the corrected `check(target)` computing `k_i = ceil(target / points[i])` and feasibility against m.
Implement binary search in `maxScore` with bounds lo=0, hi=max(points)*m.
Test against Example 1 (points=[2,4], m=3 → 4) and Example 2 (points=[1,2,3], m=5 → 2); both verified.
Test edge cases: n=2, m=1 (returns 0), large m, points with value 1; all handled.
Verify time complexity O(n log(max(points)*m)) ≈ 5·10⁴ · 60, fits constraints.
Combine all parts into the final `Solution` class.
